draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.50, the 9th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 3rd of 37 at CB. He went 3rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Stephon Gilmore. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 0 passes defended in 2021, 31st of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Houston Texans. 54 career games and 54 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (16 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 16 (100th percentile), completion % allowed 43.3% (99th percentile), passer rating allowed 54.0 (98th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 88.0% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, above the norm.
